topic: Full Spark ALS Distributed Factor Extraction and Convergence on 24.67M Ratings
problem_statement: Fit ALS Collaborative Filtering on full MovieLens 25M Train split (24,675,013 ratings) within memory constraints and verify learned factor matrices.
solution_or_decision: PySpark ALS (rank=16, maxIter=10, regParam=0.1, implicitPrefs=False, seed=42) trained successfully on 24,675,013 ratings in 85.96 seconds on local 4-thread Spark. Extracted 162,541 user factors and 58,932 item factors with exact 16 dimensions and 0 NaNs/Infs. Independent dot product verification matches Spark transform within 4.98e-7 max absolute difference.
evidence: Observed on 24,675,013 ratings: fit time 85.96s, userFactors count=162,541, itemFactors count=58,932. Independent dot product max difference=0.00000050 <= 1e-4.
